nodes.label: Premium Look Principles
nodes.rationale: Role-based home, restraint, dense tables, Cmd+K, real empty states, mobile-first for field staff

nodes.label: Two-Stage Expense Approval Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Stage 1 Regional Manager operational verification; Stage 2 Corporate Accounts GST/financial settlement; self-approval blocked

nodes.label: Blocker Categorization

nodes.label: Demo Outcome Tracking
nodes.rationale: Prevents endless non-converting trials

nodes.label: EMD PBG Tracking

nodes.label: Excel WhatsApp Fragmentation Problem
nodes.rationale: Caused missed GeM bid deadlines, untracked demo assets, double-reimbursement leakage, information silos

nodes.label: Indian Numbering Lakhs Crores
nodes.rationale: Prevents cognitive fatigue and aligns with Ministry of Finance budget sanctions

nodes.label: PQ vs General MHA Tracking
nodes.rationale: Bidder eliminated at PQ never reaches financial evaluation

nodes.label: Proposal Margin Approval
nodes.rationale: Management sign-off ensures margin integrity vs GeM L1 threshold

nodes.label: Regional Manager Territory Lock
nodes.rationale: Zonal quotas; cross-zone visibility causes conflicting customer touches; management/admin retain zone switching

nodes.label: Two-Stage Expense Sign-off
nodes.rationale: Stage 1 operational legitimacy, Stage 2 statutory GST compliance

nodes.label: Visit as Expense Approval Anchor
nodes.rationale: No hotel/conveyance expense approved unless tied to verified client visit; planned vs actual date prevents fabricated claims

nodes.label: Warranty Status Surfacing
nodes.rationale: Liquidated damages if scanner inoperative past 24 hours

nodes.label: Arihant BOS Design System & Component Library
nodes.norm_label: arihant bos design system & component library

nodes.label: Clean Light Executive Theme
nodes.rationale: Engineered for defence/security enterprise workflows; visual consistency across modules

nodes.label: Component-Driven Architecture
nodes.rationale: Ad-hoc styles prohibited; all views consume @/components/ui

nodes.label: No Dark Black Themes Rule
nodes.rationale: Dark backgrounds strictly prohibited anywhere in UI

nodes.label: Cron Jobs Deadline Reminders Recurring Tasks
nodes.norm_label: cron jobs deadline reminders recurring tasks

nodes.label: Locked Tech Stack
nodes.rationale: NestJS, Next.js App Router, Supabase, Kysely (no Prisma), Socket.IO, event-emitter, schedule, Cloudinary, shadcn/ui, pnpm monorepo

nodes.label: Event-Driven Bus nestjs event-emitter
nodes.rationale: No Kafka - 300 users don't need it

nodes.label: Kysely Query Builder No Prisma
nodes.rationale: Type-safe SQL; types via kysely-codegen

nodes.label: Kysely over Prisma
nodes.rationale: ORM-grade autocomplete but real SQL, no migration engine fighting you

nodes.label: Architecture Stack NestJS Next.js Supabase
nodes.rationale: For 300 users this stack is effortless

nodes.label: Frontend Design References Linear Attio Stripe HubSpot
nodes.norm_label: frontend design references linear attio stripe hubspot

nodes.label: RBAC Region Scoping in Guards
nodes.rationale: NestJS uses service_role key bypassing RLS so permissions enforced in guards

nodes.label: Build Down Not Wide
nodes.rationale: Take one feature through whole stack first; tender slice proves architecture

nodes.label: CSV Bulk User Invite
nodes.rationale: Avoid hand-adding 300 users; one role per user for pilot

nodes.label: Guards over RLS Authorization
nodes.rationale: NestJS uses service_role key; keep RLS off while building, enable as defence-in-depth before handover

nodes.label: Phase 1 8-Day Pilot
nodes.rationale: All 16 modules in 8 days solo is unrealistic; ship a deployed pilot of highest-value modules and phase the rest

nodes.label: Text CHECK Statuses vs Enums
nodes.rationale: Unfinalised statuses use text+CHECK to tune without migration; stable values are Postgres enums

nodes.label: Closing Within 7 Days KPI
nodes.rationale: GeM bid deadlines are hard digital cutoffs; missing by 1 minute disqualifies months of liaison

nodes.label: Vikas PQ vs General Tender Counts
nodes.norm_label: vikas pq vs general tender counts

nodes.label: 7 Core Field Ergonomics Mandates
nodes.rationale: Adoption is a functional requirement: minimize long forms, duplicate entry and typing.

nodes.label: Enter Once Use Everywhere
nodes.rationale: Field executives must never re-enter data at night; any action propagates to timeline, manager queue, scorecards, dashboard and audit trail.

nodes.label: Mobile-First Field UX
nodes.rationale: Sales reps and engineers are on the road; minimize typing, pre-fill, tap-friendly.

nodes.label: Tender-Value Demo Conflict Resolution
nodes.rationale: Scarce demo machines go to the opportunity with higher tender/deal value, subject to approval.
